artDefaults.promptSuffix: Three Kingdoms fantasy strategy card illustration, dramatic painterly 2D digital art, strong silhouette, ancient Chinese battlefield atmosphere, no text, no watermark, no card frame.

cards.title: 决斗
cards.description: 造成多段伤害。可消耗手牌中的杀追加攻击并施加易伤。
cards.prompt: Duel stratagem from Three Kingdoms. Two rival generals clash in single combat under torn banners, spear and sword sparks, soldiers forming a tense circle around them.

cards.title: 无中生有
cards.description: 可消耗 1 张手牌。抽牌；若成功消耗，获得能量并额外抽牌。
cards.prompt: A brilliant strategist conjures supplies from empty hands, glowing scrolls and cards materializing from mist above an ancient war table.

cards.title: 五谷丰登
cards.description: 获得格挡。可消耗 1 张手牌；所有玩家抽牌，成功消耗时你获得能量，所有玩家额外抽牌。
cards.prompt: Abundant harvest supplies arrive for an army, golden grain carts, open granaries, soldiers cheering under warm sunlight after a siege.

cards.title: 兵粮寸断
cards.description: 判定牌堆顶。若判定牌费用为 0，抽牌；否则施加虚弱和减速。若判定牌是技能牌、能力牌或费用不低于 2，额外施加虚弱和减速。
cards.prompt: Supply lines cut in a Three Kingdoms campaign, burning grain carts on a muddy road, scouts severing ropes, enemy camp starving in the distance.

cards.title: 过河拆桥
cards.description: 移除目标格挡，造成伤害并施加虚弱和易伤。移除足量格挡时获得能量并抽牌。
cards.prompt: Destroy the bridge after crossing, an ancient wooden bridge collapsing into a river, enemy cavalry stranded, tactical betrayal under storm clouds.

cards.title: 火攻
cards.description: 可弃 1 张手牌。造成伤害并施加中毒；弃牌的费用和稀有度提高收益。弃杀额外伤害，弃闪获得格挡，弃能力牌施加易伤。
cards.prompt: Fire attack stratagem, flaming arrows rain into an enemy camp at night, oil jars exploding, red smoke, tactical chaos and poison-green sparks.

cards.title: 借刀杀人
cards.description: 可消耗手牌中的杀提高伤害，并对所有敌人施加减速；没有消耗杀则抽牌。
cards.prompt: Borrowed blade assassination scheme, one general hands a gleaming saber through shadowed curtains while another enemy is framed in the distance.

cards.title: 乐不思蜀
cards.description: 判定牌堆顶并施加减速；若判定不是杀，额外减速、易伤、伤害并获得能量。
cards.prompt: Indulgent palace trap, a warlord distracted by music, dancers and wine while urgent military scrolls burn unnoticed in the background.

cards.title: 南蛮入侵
cards.description: 对所有敌人施加虚弱并造成伤害；若击杀敌人则回复生命。所有玩家获得敏捷。
cards.prompt: Southern barbarian invasion, wild armored warriors and beasts surge from jungle mist toward a fortified pass, drums and spears everywhere.

cards.title: 闪电
cards.description: 判定牌堆顶。造成随判定牌费用和稀有度提高的伤害；稀有或能力牌额外易伤。
cards.prompt: Judgment lightning spell over a battlefield, a thunderbolt strikes a marked enemy general, divination cards and storm clouds swirling overhead.

cards.title: 铁索连环
cards.description: 技能牌。杀获得溅射，但溅射不触发杀命中后续；判定技能牌或能力时追加群体伤害和能量。
cards.prompt: Iron chain formation, several enemy generals bound by glowing heavy chains across a battlefield, one strike sending shockwaves through all links.

cards.title: 顺手牵羊
cards.description: 偷取目标格挡并造成伤害、抽牌。偷取成功获得能量，否则让手牌临时变为 0 费。
cards.prompt: Clever theft in a war camp, a nimble strategist steals a guarded banner and supply token while soldiers look the wrong way.

cards.title: 桃园结义
cards.description: 所有玩家回复生命。你获得格挡、能量并抽牌。
cards.prompt: Peach Garden oath, three heroic warriors swear brotherhood beneath blooming peach trees, warm sunrise, sacred banners and falling petals.

cards.title: 万箭齐发
cards.description: 对所有敌人造成伤害。所有玩家获得力量。你获得格挡。
cards.prompt: Ten thousand arrows fired at once, the sky darkens with volleys of arrows over an ancient battlefield, shields raised, cinematic scale.

cards.title: 无懈可击
cards.description: 移除自身负面效果。每移除一种获得格挡；移除成功获得能量，否则获得基础格挡。
cards.prompt: Perfect countermeasure stratagem, a calm strategist raises a jade talisman shield that shatters curses, arrows, flames and chains at once.

cards.title: 观星
cards.description: 获得格挡。观看牌堆顶若干牌，可将部分置入弃牌堆，其余保持在牌堆顶。
cards.prompt: Zhuge Liang star-gazing strategy, a robed strategist observes a star map and celestial cards above a quiet mountain altar at night.

cards.title: 龙胆
cards.description: 获得格挡。此后每回合第一张杀或闪本回合费用变为 0。
cards.prompt: Zhao Yun Dragon Courage technique, a white-armored spear hero swaps offense and defense in a blue dragon aura, cutting through arrows and blades.
